_comment: Where the Yoyo Gyms app is allowed to navigate.
THE SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH for two things that must never drift apart:
Capacitor's `allowNavigation` (what the WebView may open inside the app)
and the entry screen's own validation (where it may send someone). If the
screen sent a member somewhere the WebView would not open, the app would
hand them to the system browser mid-registration — typing personal details
into a plain tab with none of the app's chrome around it.
`npm run mobile:configure` regenerates www/config.js from this file, and
capacitor.config.ts reads the same list. Edit here and nowhere else.
WHY THERE IS NO 'enter your server address' SCREEN, unlike some shells:
Yoyo Gyms is ONE deployment serving every gym, each as a schema in the
same project (D-096). The address does not vary per gym and must not be
typed by a member. What varies is WHICH GYM, and that is resolved by slug
through search or a scanned QR (D-036). A shell that asked a gym member
for a server address would be asking a question they cannot answer.
⚠️ THE STAFF PANEL MUST NOT BE REACHABLE FROM THIS APP.
`adminHost` below is recorded and DELIBERATELY ABSENT from allowedHosts.
The Yoyo Gyms admin panel is for platform staff — different people,
different permissions, and the screens that approve gyms and read the
audit log. Staff reach it in a browser, never through this app.
Right now the panel shares a host with the member screens, so this list
CANNOT exclude it by host alone. Two defences stand today:
1. every staff route requires a permission a gym owner does not have,
and refuses with 403 (D-128, and the tests that cover it);
2. the entry screen never links there.
That is defence in depth, not host isolation. Serving the panel from its
own hostname is recorded as the intended fix — see ASSUMPTIONS below.
PLACEHOLDER DOMAINS. yoyogyms.com is NOT registered as of 2026-09-22. An
unregistered domain in an allow list is a name somebody else can buy, and
this list decides where a member may type their ID number. Replace both
entries with the real address before any build leaves this machine.
